```{r Read in and clean MANG data}
# 225 obs.

max(MANG_current_status0$year) 

# NOTE TO SELF: PURG this file? Don't need it... - Nov 2026

# 9 obs.

# NOTE TO SELF: I actually don't think we need trend right now. We'll keep it until I decide not to. - Nov 2026

# 5 obs.


# Current Status / Condition:

```

```{r Join MANG dataframes together}
# Join MANG trend, current_status, and extent
colnames(MANG_current_status)
colnames(MANG_extent)
colnames(MANG_trend)

MANG <- MANG_current_status %>%
  left_join(MANG_extent, by = c("rgn_id", "year")) %>%
  left_join(MANG_trend,  by = c("rgn_id")) %>%
  mutate(habitat = "MANG") %>%
  select(habitat, rgn_name, rgn_id, year, 
         current_status, extent_km2, extent_source, trend, 
         MANG_include_exclude_CEDO= MANG_include_exclude) %>%
  mutate(
    current_status = round(current_status, 2),
    extent_km2 = round(extent_km2, 2)
  )
# 225 obs., 9 vars.
```

```{r Gapfill the seagrass data from 2003 to 2025 assuming the null}
table(SEAG0$year)

SEAG_START = 2003 # The year after the reference year, 2002
SEAG_END = 2025

SEAG <- SEAG0 %>%
  select(habitat, rgn_name, rgn_id,
         current_status, extent_km2, extent_source, trend,
         SEAG_include_exclude_LitRev) %>%
  crossing(
    year = SEAG_START:SEAG_END
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    extent_source = "Literature review for contemporary condition in 2025; ref. ~2002"
  ) %>%
  relocate(year, .before = current_status) %>%
  arrange(rgn_id, year)
# 207 obs., 9 vars.

```

```{r Clean HS_weights0 before merging}
# Select necessary columns and lowercase habitat names
colnames(HS_weights0)

HS_weights <- HS_weights0 %>%
  select(habitat= habitat_type, 
         PRO_weight = coastal_protection_score,
```

```{r Merge HS_weights to HS_df}

  left_join(

    by = c("habitat")
  )

```

# Estimate PRO

#  Calculate HS_current_status sub-scores

```{r Calculate PRO_Scores}
colnames(HS_df)

# Calculate carbon, filtration, and protection score
PRO_Scores0 <- HS_df %>%
  select(habitat, rgn_name, rgn_id, year,
         extent_km2, current_status, trend, PRO_weight) %>%
  group_by(rgn_name, rgn_id, year) %>%
  
  summarise(
    PRO_score = sum(current_status * extent_km2 * PRO_weight, na.rm = TRUE) /
      sum(extent_km2 * PRO_weight, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    n_habitats = n_distinct(habitat[!is.na(PRO_weight)]),
    habitats = paste(
      habitat[!is.na(PRO_weight)][order(-extent_km2[!is.na(PRO_weight)])],
      collapse = ", "
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
#  297 obs., 6 vars.

HS_EVAL_START= 2003
HS_EVAL_END= 2020
  
PRO_Scores <- PRO_Scores0 %>%
  filter(year >= HS_EVAL_START, year <= HS_EVAL_END) %>%
  bind_rows(
    filter(., year == HS_EVAL_END) %>%
      select(-year) %>%
      crossing(year = (HS_EVAL_END + 1):2025)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    PRO_score= round(PRO_score, 2)
  ) %>%
  arrange(rgn_id, year)
#  207 obs., 6 vars.

table(PRO_Scores$habitats)
#      MANG, WETL, CORL MANG, WETL, SEAG, CORL WETL, CORL, MANG, SEAG WETL, MANG, SEAG, CORL WETL, SEAG, CORL, MANG 
#                     23                     23                     23                     46                     46 
# WETL, SEAG, MANG, CORL 
#                     46 

```

```{r Save PRO_Scores}
write.csv(PRO_Scores,
          "/home/ferrer/ohi_goc_prep/HS/v2026/HS_Scores_1.1/PRO_Scores_1.1/PRO_Scores_df_Nov062026.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r Calculate FIL_Scores}
    n_habitats = n_distinct(habitat[!is.na(FIL_weight)]),
    habitats = paste(
      habitat[!is.na(FIL_weight)][order(-extent_km2[!is.na(FIL_weight)])],
      collapse = ", "
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
#  297 obs., 6 vars.

HS_EVAL_START= 2003
HS_EVAL_END= 2020
  
FIL_Scores <- FIL_Scores0 %>%
  filter(year >= HS_EVAL_START, year <= HS_EVAL_END) %>%
  bind_rows(
    filter(., year == HS_EVAL_END) %>%
      select(-year) %>%
      crossing(year = (HS_EVAL_END + 1):2025)
  ) %>%

    FIL_score= round(FIL_score, 2)
  ) %>%
```


```{r Calculate SEQ_Scores}
# NOTE TO SELF: Beward of SEQ units. In the lit review they are given in gC m2, but we need them in km2.

SEQ_Scores0 <- HS_df %>%
  select(habitat, rgn_name, rgn_id, year,
         extent_km2, current_status, trend, SEQ_weight_gC.m2.yr) %>%
  group_by(rgn_name, rgn_id, year) %>%
  mutate(
    SEQ_weight = SEQ_weight_gC.m2.yr / 1000000
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    SEQ_score = sum(current_status * SEQ_weight * extent_km2, na.rm = TRUE) /
      sum(SEQ_weight * extent_km2, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_habitats = n_distinct(habitat[!is.na(SEQ_weight)]),
    habitats = paste(
      habitat[!is.na(SEQ_weight)][order(-extent_km2[!is.na(SEQ_weight)])],
      collapse = ", "
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
#  297 obs., 6 vars.

HS_EVAL_START= 2003
HS_EVAL_END= 2020
  
SEQ_Scores <- SEQ_Scores0 %>%
  filter(year >= HS_EVAL_START, year <= HS_EVAL_END) %>%
  bind_rows(
    filter(., year == HS_EVAL_END) %>%
      select(-year) %>%
      crossing(year = (HS_EVAL_END + 1):2025)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    SEQ_score= round(SEQ_score, 2)
  ) %>%
  arrange(rgn_id, year)
# 207 obs., 6 vars.

table(SEQ_Scores$habitats)
# MANG, WETL WETL, MANG 
#         46        161 

```

```{r Save SEQ_Scores}
          row.names = FALSE)
```

# PLOT: Sub-Scores over time

```{r Read in Sub-Scores as needed}
PRO_Scores<- read_csv("/home/ferrer/ohi_goc_prep/HS/v2026/HS_Scores_1.1/PRO_Scores_1.1/PRO_Scores_df_Nov062026.csv")
FIL_Scores<- read_csv("/home/ferrer/ohi_goc_prep/HS/v2026/HS_Scores_1.1/FIL_Scores_1.1/FIL_Scores_df_Nov062026.csv")
SEQ_Scores<- read_csv("/home/ferrer/ohi_goc_prep/HS/v2026/HS_Scores_1.1/SEQ_Scores_1.1/SEQ_Scores_df_Nov062026.csv")
```

```{r Plot PRO_Scores over time}

# Make sure to order the regions:
REGION_ORDER <- c(
  "Western Upper Gulf",
  "Western Midriff Islands",
  "Western Central Gulf",
  "Western Southern Gulf",
  "Eastern Upper Gulf",
  "Eastern Midriff Islands",
  "Southern Sonora Coast",
  "Sinaloa Coast",
  "Southeastern Gulf"
)

# Region Colors:
REGION_COLORS<- c(
  "Western Upper Gulf" = "#C03729",
  "Western Midriff Islands" = "#E68C7C",
  "Western Central Gulf" = "#FC8F24",
  "Western Southern Gulf" = "#dcaa38",
  "Eastern Upper Gulf" = "#cbd2a0",
  "Eastern Midriff Islands" = "#98a25a",
  "Southern Sonora Coast" = "#747428",
  "Sinaloa Coast" = "#627391",
  "Southeastern Gulf" = "#8d61a9")

PRO_Scores_overTime <- PRO_Scores %>%
  # filter(year>= START_EVAL_PERIOD & year <= END_EVAL_PERIOD) %>%
  
  ggplot(aes(
    x = year,
    y = PRO_score,
    color = rgn_name
  )) +
  
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  
  facet_wrap(~ rgn_name, scales = "fixed") +
  
  geom_hline(yintercept = 100, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = REGION_COLORS) +
  
  labs(
    title = "PRO Scores by Region",
    subtitle = "NOTE: Gapfilled since 2021",
    caption = "updated: Nov 6 2026",
    y = "PRO Score (from 0 to 100)",
    x = "Year"
  ) +
  
  ylim(0, 101) +
  
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")
  )

PRO_Scores_overTime

```

```{r Plot SEQ_Scores over time}
REGION_COLORS<- c(
  "Western Upper Gulf" = "#C03729",
  "Western Midriff Islands" = "#E68C7C",
  "Western Central Gulf" = "#FC8F24",
  "Western Southern Gulf" = "#dcaa38",
  "Eastern Upper Gulf" = "#cbd2a0",
  "Eastern Midriff Islands" = "#98a25a",
  "Southern Sonora Coast" = "#747428",
  "Sinaloa Coast" = "#627391",
  "Southeastern Gulf" = "#8d61a9")

SEQ_Scores_overTime <- SEQ_Scores %>%
  # filter(year>= START_EVAL_PERIOD & year <= END_EVAL_PERIOD) %>%
  
  ggplot(aes(
    x = year,
    y = SEQ_score,
    color = rgn_name
  )) +
  
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  
  facet_wrap(~ rgn_name, scales = "fixed") +
  
  geom_hline(yintercept = 100, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = REGION_COLORS) +
  
  labs(
    title = "SEQ Scores by Region",
    subtitle = "NOTE: Gapfilled since 2021",
    caption = "updated: Nov 6 2026",
    y = "SEQ Score (from 0 to 100)",
    x = "Year"
  ) +
  
  ylim(0, 101) +
  
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")
  )

SEQ_Scores_overTime
```
